_comentario: 'Read and Draw', el cuaderno en inglés. Datos de origen para tools/gen_days.py --libro english. Este fichero SI se edita a mano; content/english/generated-days.tex NO (se regenera con `make generate`). Parte 1 (otoño): días 1-65, semanas 1-13, en presente. Hilo: los vecinos nuevos de Londres -- ver notes/05-english.md.

personajes.Dani: su hermano, 5 años; le encantan los dinosaurios
personajes.Toby: el perro de la familia: marrón, de orejas largas, con su pelota roja
personajes.Grandma Rosa: la abuela, la madre de Mum
personajes.Amy: la vecina nueva, de Londres; 7 años, pelo rojo y rizado; cuando no sabe una palabra, la dibuja
personajes.Sam: el hermano de Amy, 5 años; también le encantan los dinosaurios
personajes.Mr y Mrs Brown: los padres de Amy y Sam; Mrs Brown es veterinaria, Mr Brown cocina
personajes.Pip: el loro de los Brown: verde, alas azules, cola roja, pico amarillo; habla
personajes.Marta: la maestra de Lucía (y de Amy)

texto: A big white van stops next to Lucía's house.
Two men take out a blue sofa and three boxes.
Lucía looks out of her window. She is happy because new neighbours are coming!

actividad.prompt: Draw the van next to Lucía's house. Draw the sofa and the boxes too.
actividad.clave: A big white van; a blue sofa; three boxes.

texto: In the afternoon a green car arrives.
A man, a woman and two children get out.
The girl has got curly red hair. The boy has got a toy dinosaur that he loves.

afirmaciones: The car is green.
Three children get out of the car.
The girl has got long black hair.
The boy has got a toy dinosaur.

texto: The woman takes out a big cage.
In the cage, there is a green parrot. It has got blue wings, a red tail and a yellow beak.
Lucía laughs when the parrot says “Hello!”

actividad.prompt: Colour the parrot. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: A green parrot with blue wings, a red tail and a yellow beak.

texto: Mum takes a cake to the new neighbours.
The girl who opens the door says: “I'm Amy.”
Her brother is Sam and the parrot is Pip. They come from London, so they speak English.

actividad.instruccion: Who is it? Read and match.

texto: That night, Lucía can't sleep.
She thinks about Amy, who lives next door now.
Amy speaks English and Lucía knows some English from school.
“We can be friends,” she thinks, and she smiles.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: A big white van stops next door.
Mum takes a cake to the new neighbours.

texto: On Monday, Amy starts at Lucía's school.
She has got a purple school bag with two badges. One is a yellow star and one is a black cat.
Amy sits next to Lucía, who helps her.

actividad.prompt: Draw Amy's school bag.
comprueba: How many badges has it got?
What are the badges, and what colour are they?
actividad.clave: A purple school bag with two badges: a yellow star and a black cat.

texto: Amy doesn't speak Spanish yet, so the first day is hard.
When she doesn't know a word, she draws it!
She draws a pencil, a clock and a sandwich. Lucía tells her the words in Spanish.

preguntas.pregunta: What does Amy do when she doesn't know a word?
Who tells Amy the words in Spanish?

texto: At break time, Lucía and Amy sit on a bench.
Amy has got a sandwich that her dad makes every day. Lucía has got an apple because she loves fruit.
They share and laugh a lot.

mitades: that her dad makes every day.
When she doesn't know a word,

texto: After school, Amy's mum is at the gate.
She is a vet, so she helps sick animals.
Amy says that Pip is happy in the new house. “He says hello to everyone!” she laughs.

frases: She has got a ___ school bag with two badges.
She is a ___, so she helps sick animals.
Amy says that ___ is happy in the new house.

texto: On Friday, the class makes a big poster.
It says “Welcome, Amy!” in English and in Spanish.
Amy is very happy because now she has got a new friend. Her name is Lucía!

checklist: I know the colour of Amy's school bag.
I know what Amy does when she doesn't know a word.
I know what Amy's mum does.
actividad.prompt: Now draw you and your best friend at school.

texto: Lucía's garden is next to Amy's garden. A low fence is between them.
On sunny days, Pip's cage is on a table by the fence.
Toby lies on the grass, where he can see the cage.

actividad.prompt: Draw the two gardens, the fence, Pip's cage and Toby.
comprueba: What is between the two gardens?
actividad.clave: A low fence between the two gardens; Pip's cage on a table by the fence; Toby lying on the grass.

texto: Every morning, Amy says “Hello, Pip!” and Pip says “Hello!”
But today Pip says a new word: “Toby! Toby!”
He learns it because Lucía calls Toby all the time.

afirmaciones: Pip learns a new word today.
The new word is “Amy”.
Lucía calls Toby all the time.
Pip says “Goodbye!” every morning.

texto: When Toby hears “Toby!”, he runs to the fence.
But nobody is there, only Pip in his cage on the table!
Toby's red ball stays under the bench. Lucía laughs because Toby looks so surprised.

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in the gardens.
actividad.clave: Pip's cage on the table; Toby's red ball under the bench; Toby next to the fence.

texto: In the afternoon, Pip says “Toby!” again and again.
Every time, Toby runs to the fence and barks.
After ten times, Toby is very tired. He falls asleep while Pip is still saying his name.

sucesos: Toby runs to the fence, but nobody is there.
After ten times, Toby is very tired.

texto: On Friday, Amy has an idea. She teaches Pip a new word: “Biscuit!”
When Pip says it, Toby gets a dog biscuit.
Now Toby loves Pip's new word!

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Toby runs to the fence, but nobody is there.
When Pip says “Biscuit!”, Toby gets a biscuit.

texto: On Saturday, Amy comes to Lucía's house. Lucía shows Amy her bedroom.
The bed is under the window. It has got a yellow blanket.
Next to the bed is a bookcase that is full of books.

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía's bedroom.
comprueba: What is next to the bed?
actividad.clave: The bed under the window, with a yellow blanket; next to the bed, a bookcase full of books.

texto: Then they go to the kitchen, where Mum is making pizza.
In the living room, Dad is reading on the sofa.
Toby is asleep in his basket, next to Dad.
Amy likes Lucía's room because it is full of colours.
A teddy bear sits on the bed. A box of crayons is on the desk.
And Toby's red ball is under the bed, as always!

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in Lucía's bedroom.
actividad.clave: The teddy bear on the bed; the box of crayons on the desk; Toby's red ball under the bed.

texto: Amy says that many houses in London are tall and thin.
They have got lots of stairs. The bedrooms are at the top.
Amy's new house has got a garden, and she loves it.

actividad.instruccion: What are many houses in London like? Find two words in the text and write them.

texto: In the evening, the two families eat together in the garden.
Mr Brown brings a cake that he makes himself.
Pip says “Hello!” to everyone, and everyone laughs.

checklist: I know what Pip's new words are.
I know where Toby's red ball is.
I know what colour Lucía's blanket is.
actividad.prompt: Now draw your favourite room in your house.

texto: It is autumn in the park.
The big tree by the pond has got red and yellow leaves.
Three brown ducks are swimming in the pond. Dani and Sam jump in the leaves, which go crunch!

actividad.prompt: Draw the big tree, the pond and the ducks.
actividad.clave: A big tree with red and yellow leaves next to the pond; three brown ducks swimming in the pond.

texto: Amy finds shiny brown nuts under a big tree. “Conkers!” she shouts.
In England, children play a game that has the same name.
They put conkers on strings and try to hit other conkers.

afirmaciones: Amy finds shiny brown nuts.
The nuts are under a small bush.
In England, children play a game with conkers.
They put the conkers in a box.

texto: Lucía makes an autumn picture for Marta's class.
Her tree has got a brown trunk and orange leaves.
The sun that shines behind the tree is yellow. Under the tree, the grass is green.

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía's autumn picture. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: A brown trunk, orange leaves, a yellow sun and green grass.

texto: On the way home, it gets cold.
Sam puts on his hat because his ears are cold. Dani puts a conker in his pocket, so he can keep it.
When they get home, Mum makes hot chocolate.

mitades: In England, children play a game
Dani and Sam jump in the leaves,

texto: On Friday, the class makes a big autumn wall.
Everyone brings leaves, conkers and pine cones from the park.
Lucía's picture is in the middle, because Marta likes it a lot.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Dani and Sam jump in the leaves.
Amy finds conkers under a big tree.
The class makes a big autumn wall.

texto: On Sunday, Grandma Rosa comes to visit. She is knitting a long scarf for Dani.
It has got green and blue stripes and two red pompoms.
Dani is happy because green is his favourite colour.

actividad.prompt: Draw Dani's new scarf.
comprueba: How many pompoms has it got?
actividad.clave: A long scarf with green and blue stripes and two red pompoms.

texto: In the afternoon, Grandma roasts chestnuts in the oven.
Amy, who comes to say hello, tries one. It is her first roasted chestnut!
“It's sweet and hot!” she says, and she asks for more.

preguntas.pregunta: What does Amy say about the chestnut?

texto: Grandma tells a story about a mouse who lives in a clock.
Every hour, the clock goes “Bong!” and the mouse jumps.
Amy doesn't understand every word, but she loves the story.

actividad.instruccion: Who does what? Read and match.

texto: Amy knows a song that is about a mouse and a clock! She sings it for Grandma:

> Hickory, dickory, dock,
The mouse ran up the clock.
The clock struck one,
The mouse ran down,
Hickory, dickory, dock.

frases: Amy knows a song that is about a ___ and a clock!
She is knitting a long ___ for Dani.

texto: Before she goes home, Grandma gives Dani the scarf. It is finished!
Dani wears it all evening, even at dinner.
Toby tries to catch the pompoms, because he thinks they are balls.

checklist: I know the colours of Dani's scarf.
I know what Amy tries for the first time.
I know where the mouse in Grandma's story lives.
actividad.prompt: Now draw Grandma Rosa telling her story.

texto: It is Halloween, and the children have got costumes.
Amy is a witch with a tall black hat. Sam is a white ghost, and Dani is a green dinosaur.
Lucía is a black cat that has got long whiskers.

actividad.prompt: Draw the four children in their costumes.
comprueba: Who is the witch? What is on her head?
Who is the dinosaur? What colour is it?
What has the black cat got?
actividad.clave: Amy: a witch with a tall black hat; Sam: a white ghost; Dani: a green dinosaur; Lucía: a black cat with long whiskers.

texto: Amy explains a Halloween game from England.
Children knock on doors and say “Trick or treat!” Then the neighbours give them sweets.
Lucía thinks it is a great game, because she loves sweets!

afirmaciones: Children knock on doors.
They say “Good morning!”
The neighbours give them sweets.
Lucía doesn't like sweets.

texto: Dad and the children make a pumpkin lantern.
The pumpkin is orange, and its stalk at the top is green. Dad cuts two triangle eyes and a big smile.
When it is dark, a yellow light shines inside.

actividad.prompt: Colour the pumpkin lantern. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: An orange pumpkin with a green stalk; the eyes and the smile yellow, with the light inside.

texto: In the evening, the children go from door to door.
Toby stays at home, because he doesn't like the masks.
When Amy knocks on her own door, Pip shouts “Boo!” Everybody jumps!

actividad.adivinanza:
I am white and I fly at night.
I say “Boo!”, but I am not a parrot.
On Halloween, Sam is me!
What am I?

texto: At home, the children count their sweets. Lucía has got twelve, and Amy has got ten.
They share with Dani and Sam, who are very sleepy.
Toby gets a dog biscuit, because chocolate is bad for dogs.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: The children put on their costumes.

texto: It rains all week.
Lucía goes to school in her red raincoat and her yellow wellies.
Her umbrella is blue with white spots. She jumps in every puddle that she sees!

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía on her way to school in the rain.
actividad.clave: A red raincoat, yellow wellies and a blue umbrella with white spots.

texto: When Lucía comes home, Toby wants to go out.
He runs in the garden and rolls in the mud. Now Toby is dirty, and his ears are full of mud.
Dad gives him a bath, but Toby doesn't like it.
At home, the hall is full of wet things.
Lucía's raincoat hangs on a hook next to the door. Her yellow wellies are on the mat.
The umbrella, which is still open, is under the bench.

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in the hall.
actividad.clave: The raincoat on a hook next to the door; the wellies on the mat; the open umbrella under the bench.

texto: Amy says that in England, the fifth of November is Bonfire Night.
There are big fires and fireworks in the parks.
Toby hides under the sofa when he hears fireworks. He doesn't like loud noises.

mitades: the fifth of November is Bonfire Night.
The umbrella, which is still open,

texto: On Saturday, the sun comes out at last.
The children put on their wellies and go to the park.
There are big puddles everywhere, so they have a jumping competition. Sam wins, because he jumps the highest!

checklist: I know what colour Lucía's wellies are.
I know what Toby does in the garden.
I know what Bonfire Night is.
actividad.prompt: Now draw yourself jumping in a puddle.

texto: Today is Lucía's birthday, and she is eight! Mum makes a round chocolate cake.
There are eight candles around the edge and three strawberries in the middle.
Lucía's name, which is in white letters, is under the strawberries.

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía's birthday cake.
comprueba: How many candles are there, and where are they?
What colour are the letters of Lucía's name?
actividad.clave: A round chocolate cake; eight candles around the edge; three strawberries in the middle; Lucía's name in white letters under the strawberries.

texto: In the afternoon, Lucía's friends come to her party.
Amy gives her a book in English, which has got lots of pictures. Dani gives her a stone that looks like a heart.
Lucía says “Thank you!” to everyone.

afirmaciones: Lucía's friends come in the morning.
Amy gives Lucía a book in English.
The book hasn't got any pictures.
Dani's stone looks like a heart.

texto: At the party, everyone has got a paper hat.
Dani doesn't want his, because it is itchy. So he puts it on Toby's head!
Toby looks so funny that Lucía laughs and laughs.

actividad.instruccion: Who does what? Read Monday's, Tuesday's and today's texts again and match.

texto: When the party ends, the friends go home.
Only Amy stays, because she lives next door.
Lucía opens the English book and reads the first page. She doesn't know every word, so Amy helps her.

sucesos: Mum makes a round chocolate cake.
Lucía's friends come to her party.
Dani puts his paper hat on Toby.
Amy helps Lucía with the English book.

texto: On Saturday, Grandma Rosa comes back from the village.
She brings a lemon cake that she makes herself.
Lucía shows her the English book, and Grandma looks at the pictures. “Now you can teach me English!” says Grandma.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Mum makes a chocolate cake with eight candles.
Dani puts his paper hat on Toby.
Grandma Rosa brings a lemon cake.

texto: Toby has got a check-up at the vet's, where Mrs Brown works.
In the waiting room, there is a girl with a white rabbit.
A man has got a tortoise in a box. A boy is holding a small grey kitten.

actividad.prompt: Draw the waiting room at the vet's, with all the animals.
comprueba: Who has got the rabbit? What colour is it?
actividad.clave: Toby; a girl with a white rabbit; a man with a tortoise in a box; a boy holding a small grey kitten.

texto: Mrs Brown checks Toby's eyes, ears and teeth. Toby is scared, so he shakes a little.
“Good dog!” says Mrs Brown, and she gives him a treat.
Toby must eat fewer biscuits, because he is a bit fat!

preguntas.pregunta: Why does Toby shake? Because he is...
Why must Toby eat fewer biscuits? Because he is...

texto: Then Mrs Brown sees the other animals.
The rabbit has got a bad ear, and the tortoise isn't eating.
The kitten is very small, because it is only six weeks old. Mrs Brown helps them all.

actividad.instruccion: Who has got which animal? Read Monday's text again and match.

texto: At home, Amy says that she wants to be a vet too.
“I love animals,” she says, “and I want to help them.”
Lucía isn't sure what she wants to be. Maybe a writer, because she loves stories!

frases: At home, Amy says that she wants to be a ___ too.
Maybe a ___, because she loves stories!
Toby is scared, so he ___ a little.
The kitten is very small, because it is only six ___ old.

texto: On Friday, Toby goes for a long walk and doesn't eat any biscuits.
Lucía and Amy walk with him to the park and back.
When they get home, Toby is tired but happy.

checklist: I know which animals are at the vet's.
I know why Toby must eat fewer biscuits.
I know what Amy wants to be.
actividad.prompt: Now draw an animal that you would like to help.

texto: On Saturday morning, Mr Brown makes an English breakfast.
On each plate, there are two eggs, three sausages and some beans. There is toast too, with butter.
Dani says that it is the biggest breakfast in the world!

actividad.prompt: Draw a plate of Mr Brown's English breakfast.
comprueba: What else is on the plate?
actividad.clave: Two eggs, three sausages, some beans and toast with butter.

texto: In the afternoon, Mr Brown teaches the children to make scones.
Scones are little English cakes that you eat with jam and cream.
First, they wash their hands, because clean hands are important in a kitchen.

afirmaciones: Mr Brown makes scones with the children.
Scones are big Spanish cakes.
You eat scones with jam and cream.
The children don't wash their hands.

texto: Mr Brown puts everything on the table.
The bag of flour is next to a big bowl. The jar of jam is on the shelf, above the oven.
Toby sits under the table, because he hopes that something falls!

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in the kitchen.
actividad.clave: The bag of flour on the table, next to the bowl; the jar of jam on the shelf above the oven; Toby under the table.

texto: Mr Brown's recipe:
- Mix the flour and the butter.
- Add the milk and mix again.
- Cut circles and put them on a tray.
- A grown-up bakes them in the oven.
When the scones are ready, they smell wonderful!

actividad.instruccion: Put the recipe in order. Write 1, 2, 3 and 4.
sucesos: Mix the flour and the butter.
Add the milk and mix again.
Cut circles and put them on a tray.
A grown-up bakes them in the oven.

texto: Everyone eats the warm scones with strawberry jam and cream.
Dani gets cream on his nose, and Sam can't stop laughing.
Lucía thinks that scones are the best English thing, after Amy!

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Mr Brown makes an English breakfast.
The children wash their hands and make scones.
Everyone eats the scones with jam and cream.

texto: Pedro's cat, Luna, likes to sit on the fence.
She is white. She has got one green eye and one blue eye. Her collar, which has got a little bell, is red.
From the fence, she watches Pip's cage all day.

actividad.prompt: Draw Luna on the fence.
actividad.clave: A white cat on the fence, with one green eye and one blue eye, and a red collar with a little bell.

texto: One day, Luna jumps down into the Browns' garden.
She walks very slowly towards Pip's cage. Pip sees her and shouts “Go away! Go away!”
Luna is so surprised that she runs back to the fence.
Amy is worried, because she thinks that Luna wants to eat Pip.
Now Mrs Brown hangs the cage high, where Luna can't reach it.
Pip is safe, but he looks a bit bored.

mitades: because she thinks that Luna wants to eat Pip.
Now Mrs Brown hangs the cage high,
that she runs back to the fence.
Her collar, which has got a little bell,

texto: Lucía watches Luna and Pip for a long time.
Pip has got a little bell in his cage too.
When Pip rings his bell, Luna shakes her head and her bell rings! They are playing a game.

actividad.adivinanza:
I am small and round.
I go “Ding, ding!”
Luna has got one, and Pip has got one too.
What am I?

texto: On Friday, Lucía tells Amy about the game.
“Luna doesn't want to eat Pip,” she says. “She wants to be his friend!”
Now, every afternoon, Luna sits on the fence while Pip sings.

checklist: I know what colour Luna's eyes are.
I know what Pip shouts at Luna.
I know how Luna and Pip play.
actividad.prompt: Now draw Luna and Pip playing their game.

texto: It is December, and the school is getting ready for the Christmas show.
On the stage, there is a big yellow star that shines. Under the star, there are three paper trees.
Lucía and Amy are going to sing “Jingle Bells” in English!

actividad.prompt: Draw the stage for the Christmas show.
comprueba: What is at the top? What colour is it?
How many paper trees are there?
actividad.clave: A big yellow star on the stage, and three paper trees under it.

texto: At home, Amy makes Christmas cards for her friends.
She draws a snowman on each card, because she loves snow.
Inside, she writes “Merry Christmas!” and her name. She gives the first card to Lucía.

afirmaciones: Amy makes Christmas cards.
She draws a reindeer on each card.
Amy loves snow.
She writes “Happy Birthday!” inside.

texto: Lucía's family puts up the Christmas tree in the living room.
The tree is green, and the star on top is yellow. All the balls on the tree are red.
The present that is under the tree is blue.

actividad.prompt: Colour the Christmas tree. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: A green tree, a yellow star on top, red balls and a blue present under the tree.

texto: On Thursday, the families come to see the Christmas show.
The children sing, and the parents clap. When Lucía and Amy sing “Jingle Bells”, everyone sings too.
Grandma Rosa, Mum and Dad are very proud.

actividad.instruccion: Who is very proud of Lucía? Find three people in the text and write them.

texto: The next day, school finishes for the Christmas holidays.
Amy's family is staying in Spain for Christmas this year.
Lucía is happy, because she can spend the holidays with Amy and Pip.

checklist: I know what the Browns' parrot is called.
I know what Amy does when she doesn't know a word.
I know how Luna and Pip play.
I know which song Lucía and Amy sing.
actividad.prompt: Now draw your favourite moment of the autumn.
